items.title: Show HN: Aurora – AI Gateway built in Go
items.contentSnippet:
Every Ai project needs the same infra - API keys, providers SDKs, retry logic, cost tracking. it should be infra layer.
Aurora is a Go gateway that handles that layer, ~15MB binary, no dependencies. It proxies requests to OpenaAI, Anthropic, Gemini etc, and can convert between formats - use the OpenAi SDK and Aurora translates to Anthropic's wire format automatically. No format conversion code in backend.
It helps:
 - track costs per customer/team
 - switch models and providers without changing
